step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Nodes: Extracted nodes from distinct physical icons on the whiteboard. Top-left S3 bucket (Code & Raw Data), EC2 Airflow instance, DE + Infra Team actor, top box (Model Training & Tuning containing Glue, SageMaker Model Training, SageMaker Batch Inference), middle section (CloudWatch, EC2 Metrics Viz, S3 Selected Models), and bottom box (Production Inference containing Glue, SageMaker Batch Inference, S3 Output Bucket).
2. Exclude non-node labels: Floating text like 'CODE' and 'DATA' pointing to S3 are treated as incoming data flows to the S3 bucket node rather than standalone nodes.
3. Trace Edges: Extracted explicit directional arrows for orchestration triggers (Airflow to Glue), data reads/writes (S3 to Glue, Glue to SageMaker, SageMaker to S3), metrics ingestion (Glue/SageMaker to CloudWatch, CloudWatch to EC2 Viz), user interactions (DE Team to EC2 Viz), and model deployments (EC2 Viz to Selected Models S3, S3 to Production SageMaker).
